title: static-bound method silently shadows an ancestor's virtual when reintroduce is missing
notes:
C# requires `new` to shadow; Java requires `@Override` to override
and will warn / fail otherwise. Delphi accepts shadowing SILENTLY
unless the developer wrote `reintroduce`. Migration: an automatic
translator that picks `override` will change behaviour; picking
`new` / no-annotation matches. The SME confirms which the original
Delphi author intended. Calibrated against Indy's TIdComponent.Notification chain.
